jobs.title: Senior Platform Product Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Statista , we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.
 Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.
 We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

 Requirements 
 Define and drive the product vision and roadmap for Statista's core platform capabilities, aligning technical investments with company-wide product and business goals

 Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to accelerate platform development, improve developer experience, and unlock new capabilities for product teams

 Act as the bridge between technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring alignment on platform priorities, trade-offs, and delivery timelines

 Continuously assess platform performance, scalability, and reliability, driving improvements through data-informed decision-making and close collaboration with engineering leadership

 
 Responsabilities

 Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate between deeply technical concepts and strategic business language

 Strong analytical mindset with a structured approach to prioritization, problem-solving, and stakeholder alignment

 You thrive in cross-functional environments and are comfortable navigating ambiguity, legacy systems, and evolving technical landscapes

jobs.title: Remote Sr. Product Manager - Revenue Management - 1 year contract (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️
 Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!
 We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates. 
 With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️
 Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation. 
 
 Your Role 
 As Senior Product Manager for one of our Revenue Management teams at RoomPriceGenie, you'll own the experience where hoteliers see, trust and act on our AI-powered pricing, both in our app and embedded in our partners' PMSs through Revenue Intelligence. This is not a feature-delivery role. We're looking for a senior PM who sets the strategy and direction, makes hard trade-offs, and turns complex pricing logic into decisions a hotelier can make in seconds.
 You'll lead a team of engineers, collaborate closely with design and research and work closely with leadership, Account Management, Integrations, Customer Success and Sales. Your mission: make RoomPriceGenie the pricing tool thousands of independent hotels rely on every day.
 
 What you'll do 
 Product Vision & Strategy 
 Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area, anchored in clear business goals: adoption, retention, revenue uplift and expansion.

 Decide what not to build, and bring stakeholders along on why.

 Shape how pricing shows up across surfaces, from our core app to partner integrations and multi-property accounts.

 Champion simplicity and explainability: hoteliers should understand why a price was recommended and feel confident acting on it.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION 
 To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.
 What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.
 In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.
 And we’re a long way from done!

 THE ROLE 
 Changing your car should feel like one seamless journey, not a series of disconnected tasks. Right now it's the opposite: people value their car in one place, search for the next one in another, and manage the handover somewhere else, much of it on the web and most of it forgotten between car changes. The Carwow app is our most direct relationship with those customers, and today it is nowhere near what it could be. 
 We are reimagining it. If we can give people a reason to open Carwow between car changes, understand what they drive and what they want next, and make the moment of changing effortless, the app becomes the place UK drivers start. This role is the product voice at the table for that: setting the direction for what we build and working day to day with design and engineering to build it. 
 This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. The best consumer apps of the next few years won't be lists with filters; they will understand you and act on your behalf. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, the fluency to prototype it quickly with the latest tools, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise. 
 If you want to shape a new consumer product from the ground up, work at the cutting edge of applied AI, and build things that millions of UK drivers could use, this is it.
  
 WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING 
 Product Strategy & Execution: 
 Set the product direction for the Carwow consumer app, defining what we build, in what order, and why 

 Lead discovery work with consumers: interviews, usage data, behavioural analysis, to build a precise understanding of where the app can add the most value 

 Identify, prototype and ship opportunities to bring AI into the app: smarter discovery, personalisation and recommendations that actually change behaviour 

 Collaborate with the Engineering Manager, Designer and Engineers as a product trio to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics 

 Manage the backlog with commercial awareness, prioritising work that drives engagement, retention and revenue, not just activity

 
 Design & Engineering Partnership: 
 Work shoulder to shoulder with design to shape journeys and screens from the ground up, and test them with users before engineering starts 

 Work with engineers on the right trade-offs for a native app: release cadence, quality and what to build versus reuse 

 Use AI tools every day in your own work, prototyping, synthesising research and analysing data, so the squad learns faster and ships more

 
 Cross-functional Leadership: 
 Work across product, engineering, data, CRM and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently 

 Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal 

 Own the app's success measures and bring clean evidence, including holdouts and controlled tests, to decisions on what to scale, change or stop

Upsun is the software factory for human-AI workflows. We give teams one unified platform to create, review, deploy, and run software, with AI agents and humans working in sync.     • Secure, compliant environments by default

Our values: 

🌿 We make a positive impact.

✨ We aim for the stars.

💚 We care for each other.

You own the strategy and the roadmap for your area, working closely with engineering to define platform behavior, build scalable abstractions, and shape workflows that empower modern development teams. jobs.title: Senior Project Manager D365 CRM
jobs.description:
Digitale transformatie is pas echt succesvol wanneer strategie, technologie en mensen samenkomen. Als Senior Projectmanager bij HSO leid jij CRM-implementaties die organisaties helpen beter met hun klanten te werken. Je werkt met de nieuwste Microsoft Cloud-technologie en stuurt teams aan in uitdagende projecten. Daarbij combineer je overzicht, leiderschap en inhoudelijke betrokkenheid. Zo maak jij het verschil tussen een systeem implementeren en echte businessimpact realiseren

Taken
- Als Senior Projectmanager leid je Dynamics 365 CRM-implementaties bij onze klanten van start tot succesvolle livegang. Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de voortgang, kwaliteit, scope en het budget van je projecten, en zorgt dat teams en stakeholders steeds dezelfde koers varen.
- Je werkt op het snijvlak van business en technologie. Samen met de klant vertaal je strategische doelen naar een duidelijke projectaanpak en een haalbare roadmap. Je begeleidt workshops, structureert requirements en zorgt dat CRM-processen zoals sales, marketing en service effectief worden ondersteund door Dynamics 365.
- Binnen het project stuur je een multidisciplinair team van (business) consultants, developers en solution architects aan. Je houdt overzicht over planning en afhankelijkheden, stuurt actief op risico’s en zorgt dat beslissingen tijdig worden genomen. Daarbij weet je complexe trajecten te structureren en verwachtingen van stakeholders op verschillende niveaus te managen.
- Onze projecten maken vaak deel uit van bredere Microsoft Cloud-transformaties, waarbij oplossingen zoals Dynamics 365 CRM, Field Service en Power BI samenkomen. In deze omgeving zorg jij voor structuur, richting en resultaat – en help je klanten niet alleen een systeem te implementeren, maar hun manier van werken daadwerkelijk te verbeteren.

Vereisten
- Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met CRM-implementaties als Projectmanager - dit is essentieel!
- Je deelt onze mindset: kritisch denken, ondernemend zijn en resultaatgericht werken.
- Uitstekende beheersing van het Engels voor internationale projecten.
- Jouw managementvaardigheden zijn consultatief, anticiperend en inspirerend, waardoor het team effectief functioneert.
- Ervaring met het Microsoft-platform, met name Dynamics 365 CRM, is een pre.
- Aantoonbare kennis van projectmanagementmethodieken, zoals PRINCE2, PMI of IPMA C/D-certificering.

Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden:
- Een competitief salaris, een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties;   
- 25 Vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 35 van te maken;   
- Hybride werken, vanuit huis, op kantoor (Rotterdam, Veenendaal); 
- EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget – we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote;   
- Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan;   
En vooral een leven lang leren. Op dag één start jouw onboardingprogramma, daarnaast krijg je een persoonlijk studiebudget dat je kunt inzetten voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling en ontvang je ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
We are the platform turning browsing into shopping . We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands.

 We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.

 In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company , creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia.

 Ready to spark your growth with us?

 WHO WE LOOK FOR 🦄 

 Flipp + Shopfully’s Product team focuses on driving adoption and revenue of our products by identifying the biggest market opportunities, building the case for investing in them, and shipping solutions with engineering, all while representing the voice of our merchant customers.

 About the role 

 The Senior Product Manager is a senior, commercially minded product leader who already understands digital advertising. This role requires a strong strategic thinker with good business sense and solid hands-on product skills who leads opportunity identification, builds decision-ready business cases, and works with engineering to ship.

 You will work closely with Sales, Engineering, Data, and Marketing teams across markets to align on key business objectives. By combining market insight, customer feedback, and industry trends, you will make sure our products resonate with merchants and drive growth. We’re looking for someone who can ramp up quickly and contribute independently.

 WHAT YOU WILL DO 🏄

 Market Understanding and Opportunity Identification

 
 Work with Product Marketing, Sales Engineering and customer-facing teams to understand customer needs and prioritize the opportunities that matter most.

 Find the highest-leverage areas to invest in, and weigh customer demand against our resources, capabilities and strategic direction.

 Turn complex questions into clear priorities. For example: how do we create more value for retail partners as their strategies move toward e-commerce? How do we find and build opportunities at scale as products launch in new markets?

 
 Business Cases and Strategy

 
 Build business cases that size opportunities, weigh revenue trade-offs, and structure a clear recommendation so leadership can make a decision.

 Own your recommendations, and be ready to explain them and adapt them as you learn.

 Lead the strategy for how our products differentiate from competitors in the market.

 Partner with Sales and Finance on pricing and monetization so our offering stays cohesive.

 
 Product Discovery and Delivery

 
 Lead discovery with merchants, advertisers, and internal teams to define problems worth solving.

 Prioritise ruthlessly, balancing revenue impact, effort, and strategic fit.

 Work hands-on with engineering to define requirements and ship, from alpha and testing through broad launch.

 Partner with Sales and Marketing on launch timing and readiness, and run retrospectives on past launches to improve future ones.

 
 Alignment and Stakeholder Management

 
 Generate cross-functional alignment (Engineering, Data, Sales, Marketing, Content) with a shared focus on goals and timing.

 Work across markets and levels of seniority, including senior leadership, with confidence.

 Track progress and impact of product initiatives and communicate results clearly.

 Build relationships with industry analysts, partners, and customers, and represent Flipp + Shopfully at conferences and industry events where relevant.

 
 WHAT YOU WILL NEED 🪄

 Must-haves

 
 Digital advertising foundations: supply vs. demand, how exchanges, SSPs, and DSPs work, programmatic bidding, pricing models (CPM, CPC, CPV), and fill rate and yield. Ideally gained in ad tech, a retail media network, a publisher, or a marketplace.

 Proven experience building business cases: sizing opportunities, weighing revenue trade-offs, and structuring recommendations for decisions.

 High autonomy: you figure things out, own the outcome and don’t need close management.

 Genuine excitement about using AI tools and rethinking how work gets done.

 Hands-on product skills: discovery, prioritisation, and working with engineering to ship, not only strategy.

 Stakeholder management, with the confidence to work across markets and levels of seniority.

 A scrappy, curious and confident approach. You’re hungry to make an impact.

 
 👉 At our company, we value diversity and actively encourage it — we believe a variety of perspectives and backgrounds makes us stronger. We focus on potential rather than on having a “perfect” CV. If this role excites you and you believe you could grow into it — even if you don’t tick every single box in the requirements — we’d love to hear from you! 

 NICE TO HAVE 🎆

 
 Retail, CPG, or retail media background

 Le rôle
 En tant que Data Migration Project Manager , tu pilotes les projets de migration des données clients vers Dastra, du cadrage jusqu'à la livraison.
 À la croisée de la gestion de projet, de la data et du conseil client , ton rôle est majoritairement orienté pilotage et accompagnement client (environ 70 %) , tout en étant suffisamment à l'aise avec la data et la technique pour comprendre, structurer et mapper les données.

 Piloter tes projets de migration de A à Z

jobs.title: Product Manager, Pricing
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

We're looking for a Product Manager to own Pricing within our Growth team across Deliveroo and Wolt! This role operates across 40+ markets in EMEA, and sits at the heart of our marketplace: Our fee strategy directly shapes consumer conversion, order frequency, PnL outcomes - and connects deeply to rider earnings and merchant economics across the Globe. You'll be responsible for building a pricing strategy and experimentation roadmap that grows revenue and profitability sustainably, without compromising the customer experience.

This is a very high-visibility role. You'll partner closely with Leadership, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Operations to design, launch, and iterate on pricing experiments across all markets, from delivery fee and service fee algorithms to 0-1 new ventures. You'll be expected to build a strong testing culture, translate ambiguous commercial questions into a rigorous experimentation agenda, and communicate results and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders. 

About the Team

Our ambition is simple: make our platform an affordable, daily habit for all users.

The Pricing team builds the systems and experiences that touch every single order — from delivery options to promotions, fees, and entirely new pricing models. Operating across 40+ markets, our work sits at the intersection of customer value, growth, and marketplace economics.

Small changes at this scale can change how customers perceive us, how often they order, and the economics of the entire marketplace. We bring together consumer psychology, experimentation, data science, economics, and product craft to answer one deceptively difficult question: How do we make every order feel like great value while driving sustainable growth?

What You’ll Do

  • Own the end-to-end strategy and roadmap for a portfolio of global pricing products.
  • Identify and launch major growth opportunities across affordability, conversion, frequency, revenue, and profitability.
  • Drive 0 to 1 big bets through validation, launch, then scale them 100X.
  • Partner deeply with Data Science and ML Engineering to design pricing algorithms, experiments, and scalable platform capabilities.
  • Develop hypotheses, launch experiments, interpret results, and turn learnings into product strategy.
  • Define the metrics and decision frameworks used to evaluate customer value, growth, and marketplace economics.
  • Communicate strategy, results, and tradeoffs to senior leaders across DoorDash.

What We’re Looking For

You might be a great fit if you:

  • Have significant product management experience building complex consumer, marketplace, growth, or monetization products.
  • Are deeply analytical and comfortable using experimentation and data to make high-stakes product decisions.
  • Are comfortable working closely with Data Science and ML Engineering on algorithmic or optimization problems.
  • Can turn ambiguous commercial questions into clear and executable product hypotheses and roadmaps.
  • Can operate as a “conductor” — aligning technical, operational, and business stakeholders and stitching together strategy, execution, and influence across teams.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo and Wolt, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Vertical Search
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

Vertical search is where we combine public sources with premium vertical data and shape the result into a product for a specific use case. This role owns that layer end to end. You decide which industries and use cases we productize. With the data team, you find and evaluate the public and premium data providers behind each one. You shape the product surface that sits on top.

You will sit with customers in these industries, learn how they actually work, and turn their needs and pain points into clear specs. You will build with engineering, ship it, and make sure go-to-market knows how to sell it. You own the outcome, not just the handoff: from the first market call through to adoption and revenue.

The hard part is choosing. There are more verticals worth building than we can build, and the difference between a good year and a wasted one is knowing which ones to invest in and which to walk away from, even when a large customer is asking for another.

In your first year, we expect you to know our top use cases better than anyone here, ship a product built for one of them that customers will pay more for, and have a defensible view of what comes next.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, research, data, and go-to-market.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Own the vertical roadmap. You decide where we invest, what we ship for each, and when a vertical is not worth it.
  • Shape the product surface on top of the data, so a customer gets something built for their job.
  • Find and evaluate the data behind each vertical, across public sources and paid providers, and decide what is worth investing in.
  • Sit with customers in these industries until you understand their workflow, then turn that into specs engineering can build.
  • Set what a good answer looks like in each use case, working with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it.
  • Work with customer success to learn what customers ask us for and what makes them leave.
  • Partner with the search owner on how results should be ranked and shaped for each use case.

We expect you to have: 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion in search, data, or industry-specific AI products.
  • Experience building products for a specific industry or use case, combined with enough technical depth to work directly on the data underneath: where it comes from, how good it is, and what it takes to make it usable.
  • A track record of real customer discovery: you have gone deep on how a particular kind of team works, and shipped something because of what you found.
  • Experience in API-first or developer-platform businesses.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how search and retrieval systems fit into agentic workflows.
  • A technical background, through a degree in computer science or engineering or equivalent hands-on experience, with the ability to engage deeply with technical architecture and tradeoffs.
  • The ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority.

It will be an added bonus if you have:

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Search Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.

When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.

The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.

The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.

In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. You will work day to day with our search engineering and research teams, with the evaluation team, and with customer success, who bring us quality feedback from real accounts every week. Our search engineers are deeply experienced in large-scale retrieval, and the product team is small, so you will argue your case directly with the people building it. That only works if you have built at this scale yourself.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Set the quality bar and release criteria for search: what good means per use case, and what a change has to clear before it ships. Our evaluation team owns the measurement, and you work closely with them on what to measure and why.
  • Own the depth, latency, and cost tradeoffs across our search products, and make them explicit and defensible.
  • Shape the direction of our index: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what quality bar it has to meet.
  • Build a point of view on where search infrastructure is going as agents, rather than people, become the main consumer, and turn that into a roadmap.
  • Know how we compare to the alternatives customers evaluate, and drive the work that closes the gaps that matter.
  • Work with customer success and directly with customers to understand where our results fall short in real workflows, and turn that into quality priorities.
  • Partner with the data and vertical product owners on what our corpus needs to contain and how results should be shaped per industry.

We expect you to have: 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion spent on high-scale search or ranking systems: web search, feed ranking at a large social platform, or a large ad engine.

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Owner – Platform (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Rolle Vom Kundenportal bis zur Rückgabe: Du prägst die Roadmap unserer Plattform. 
Unsere Plattform ist das Herzstück von Everphone. Über sie bestellen Geschäftskunden Smartphones, Tablets und Laptops für ihre Mitarbeitenden, rollen sie aus und geben sie am Ende zurück. Als (Senior) Product Owner (w/m/d) übernimmst du einen Bereich dieser Plattform und gestaltest gemeinsam mit deiner Squad aus Engineers die nächsten Features. Du sprichst mit Kunden sowie mit Operations, Customer Success und Sales. So findest du heraus, wo es wirklich hakt, und machst daraus Lösungen, die im Alltag funktionieren. AI ist dabei dein tägliches Werkzeug: Du analysierst, baust Prototypen und automatisierst damit, und du prägst mit, wie wir als Team mit AI arbeiten. Wenn du gern tief in komplexe Prozesse einsteigst und Dinge vorantreibst, ist diese Rolle für dich gemacht.

 Deine Aufgaben Produktbereich verantworten 
 Strategie und Roadmap: Du entwickelst Strategie und Roadmap deines Produktbereichs und verantwortest das Backlog.
 Priorisierung: Du arbeitest mit Operations & Logistics, Customer Success und Sales und machst aus ihren konkurrierenden Anforderungen klare Prioritäten.
 Projekte: Du steuerst mehrere Vorhaben parallel, etwa neue Nutzerrollen mit Freigabeprozessen oder die Anbindung von Partnerportalen.
 Neue Servicemodelle: Gemeinsam mit Sales und unseren Kunden bewertest du Ideen für neue Servicemodelle, bevor sie in die Umsetzung gehen.
 Kunden und Prozesse 
 Gerätelebenszyklus: Du verstehst die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden und ihrer Mitarbeitenden entlang des gesamten Gerätelebenszyklus, von Bestellung und Rollout bis zu Support, Reparatur und Rückgabe. Daraus leitest du klare, gut geschnittene Anforderungen ab.
 Adoption: Du treibst die Adoption voran und holst regelmäßig Nutzerfeedback ein.
 Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Du validierst Ideen früh und automatisierst manuelle Schritte in unseren Serviceprozessen.
 AI und KPIs 
 AI in der Produktarbeit: Du nutzt AI für die Analyse von Kundenfeedback und Daten und für Produktartefakte.
 Prototypen: Du baust Prototypen selbst, damit Ideen schneller validiert werden.
 KPIs: Du definierst und verfolgst Produkt-KPIs und stellst sicher, dass dein Produktbereich messbar zu den Zielen von Everphone beiträgt.

 KI-Tools ab Tag eins: Moderne KI-Tools stehen allen Rollen zur Verfügung, nicht nur dem Tech-Team
 Gestaltungsspielraum: Du darfst Prozesse hinterfragen und mit KI neu bauen. Eigene Automatisierungen und Tools sind ausdrücklich erwünscht
 Voneinander lernen: Kolleg:innen teilen offen, wie sie ihre Arbeit mit KI neu aufgebaut haben, und du lernst direkt aus der Praxis

 Gesundheit: Bezuschusste Urban-Sports-Club-Mitgliedschaft und kostenfreie, vertrauliche mentale Unterstützung über Voiio
 Gemeinschaft 
 Im Office: Wöchentliche bezahlte Company Lunches und Frühstücks-Events, frisches Obst, Snacks und Kaffeespezialitäten. Und dein Hund ist auch willkommen

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Wanna join the adventure? 

 
 At Loft, we are convinced that space programs should not have to be rebuilt from scratch every time. Our philosophy has been to productize them: we develop our own proprietary technology blocks, hardware and software, so that a customer payload can be integrated faster and more reliably than any bespoke program allows. That approach has delivered — it is why our customers reach orbit in months rather than years, and it is what makes working here different from working in the rest of the industry.

 We are now taking the next step: launching and operating our own constellations, and building a new set of services on top of them. That includes a full product suite enabling third-party AI applications to run directly onboard our satellites, and a growing ecosystem of partners whose needs we have to understand and design for. Loft is expanding at a very high pace, and the range of what we build is expanding just as fast.

 This is why Product Management matters so much here. Someone has to hold the whole picture — what is technically possible, what customers actually need, what we should build first — and turn it into something engineering and leadership can act on. As a Product Manager, you will own a significant perimeter and the autonomy that goes with it. We are growing the team precisely so that each of us can go deeper on our topics, anticipate rather than react, and have more impact across the company.

 You will need to be comfortable talking to anyone here. In the same week you might sit with a system engineer to understand a design constraint, join a BD call with an institutional customer, and present a recommendation to the executive team. Ideas at Loft get discussed openly and on their merits, wherever they come from, so being able to ask a naive question without ego — and to disagree with someone senior without making it personal — matters more than seniority.

 About this role: 
 Understand what is possible, and turn it into requirements 

 
 Spend the bulk of your time with engineering: understanding architectures, constraints, and dependencies well enough to judge what is realistically doable in a given timeframe.

 Translate strategic direction into clear requirements and use cases that engineering can act on directly, and follow them down to the Jira tickets.

 Surface and shape the good ideas that come from engineering — many of the best ones do — and connect them to a product rationale.

 Define success criteria for each capability, and verify they are actually met through implementation and delivery.

 Maintain an accurate, shared view of Loft's product capabilities, what is in development, and where the gaps are.

 
 Bring the outside in 

 
 Run customer discovery interviews alongside business development, and debrief missions to see how Loft's capabilities are actually used in operations.

 Engage directly with the partners building on our platform, including the onboard AI application ecosystem, to understand their needs and constraints.

 Track market trends and competitive moves closely enough to know where our offering stands.

 Decide and prioritize 

 
 Own the roadmap for your perimeter, reconciling customer needs, engineering reality, and Loft's strategy into a single coherent plan.

 Build the analysis behind every recommendation — sizing, segmentation, business cases, operational data — so decisions are grounded in evidence rather than intuition alone.

 Negotiate scope and delivery commitments with engineering leadership, and re-plan when capacity or mission timelines shift.

 Challenge, constructively and with data, business development, engineering leadership, and your own assumptions.

 Communicate 

 
 Own internal communication on your perimeter: keep engineering, program leadership, and executives working from the same technical reality.

 Develop the technical narratives and proof points that marketing and BD then turn into their own customer-facing material.

 Prepare recommendations and presentations for top-executive-level audiences.

 
 
 Must Haves: 
 
 7+ years of professional experience, including hands-on product management.

 Domain experience in at least one of: earth observation, embedded systems, aerospace systems, security & defense.

 Comfort at both ends of the spectrum — understand the market, and the technology

 Structured and data-driven: you bring your experience and your intuitions, but when you put a recommendation on the table you can show the analysis it stands on.

 Real product obsession: you think about the bigger picture and product-market fit before you think about features.

 Relentless curiosity. In a single month you might move from a satellite bus constraint, to onboard AI inference, to a defense accreditation requirement — and you need to find that stimulating rather than exhausting.

 High autonomy and a bias for action: handed a broad perimeter, you organize it yourself and come back with a plan.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Product and GTM Enablement
jobs.description:
About the Role 
  
 We are looking for a Senior Manager - Product & GTM Enablement to lead and grow our Revenue Enablement function. You will own our enablement strategy and lead a team of two, ensuring the entire Revenue organization is equipped to sell, implement, and support DataSnipper with confidence.

 You will be the connective tissue between Product, Product Marketing, and our Revenue organization, ensuring that every new product release, capability update, and strategic shift is understood, internalized, and actionable by our field teams. You will work closely with PMs and the broader Product team to translate roadmap developments into role-specific enablement that reaches leaders, managers, and individual contributors alike.

 This role requires someone who can operate autonomously, manage and develop a small team, and move quickly in a fast-paced environment without sacrificing quality or alignment.
  
  
 About DataSnipper 
  
 We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

 At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

 We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers.

 Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, we've built a strong foundation for what's next. And as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.
 
 What You Will Do
 
 Team Leadership and Management
 Lead, manage, and develop a team of two Enablement Managers, setting clear goals, providing regular coaching, and creating space for them to grow

 Own the team's roadmap and prioritization, ensuring work is aligned to the highest-leverage opportunities across the Revenue organization

 Operate autonomously with strong judgment on when to escalate versus drive independently

 Product Enablement and GTM Readiness
 Partner closely with Product Managers and Product Marketing to stay ahead of the roadmap, translating upcoming releases into role-specific enablement before they reach the field

 Design and deliver launch enablement for new product features and capabilities, ensuring leaders, managers, and ICs are equipped to speak to and demonstrate them confidently

 Build and maintain a scalable product knowledge infrastructure including training materials, release notes for the field, and quick-reference guides that keeps the team current as the product evolves

 Serve as the go-to internal resource for questions about how DataSnipper works, what has changed, and how to position new capabilities

 Revenue Enablement Programs
 Design and deliver enablement programs that span the full revenue team including AEs, CSMs, SEs, and frontline managers, aligned to where they are in the customer lifecycle

 Build and run discovery, value realization, and objection-handling training that prepares the field for tough conversations with technical and finance buyers

 Develop and maintain playbooks, training workbooks, and enablement assets that provide consistent depth and are usable by a global team across time zones

 Measure the impact of enablement programs through clear metrics and use data to continuously improve quality, coverage, and field performance

 Cross-functional Collaboration
 Act as the primary point of contact between Product, PMM, and the Revenue org for all enablement-related alignment

 Build strong relationships with Revenue leaders and managers to surface gaps, gather feedback, and ensure enablement stays relevant

 Contribute to a culture of continuous learning across the Revenue organization

 
 What You Bring
 
 7+ years of experience in revenue enablement, sales enablement, or a closely adjacent role within B2B SaaS

 Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team, with the ability to set direction, give feedback, and develop people

 Proven ability to work closely with Product and PMM to translate roadmap developments into field-ready enablement at pace

 Hands-on experience building enablement programs from scratch including training curricula, playbooks, and launch frameworks, not just delivering pre-made content

jobs.title: Social & Follower - Product Manager
jobs.description:
We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting), with 25+ nationalities and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our collective travel belts. What we have in common, beyond very well-worn passports, is this: We want to change the way people travel. That's exactly what we're doing, with the app that lets you plan, track, and relive every trip. Polarsteps has over 20 million users already. For us, this is just the beginning.
  
 Your expedition: Product & Growth
  
 This role is about the heartbeat of Polarsteps, the social layer that keeps travelers connected to the people who care about their journeys. You'll own the Social & Follower experience. Your users are followers & travelers; think about features that help travelers share what they're experiencing and help followers stay close from a distance. You are responsible for the engagement mechanics; think about how to make followers feel involved, not just informed, turning a passive audience into a real homefront community.
  
 While innovating on this engagement, you will also be owning one of the most important growth loops of our business: the social viral loop. Here you'll be working closely working together with other teams that use the share flow, while also closely collaborating with our Growth & Marketing team who are in contact with resources like our Polarsteps Pioneers .
  
 The social viral loop is one of Polarsteps' core growth engines, and it deserves both love (features that make sharing feel fun and effortless - like our route sharing feature ) and brains (the thinking to optimize the numbers behind it). This is a role for someone who gets excited about optimizing the % in a growth loop and, in parallel, wants to grow product strategy skills on an important part of the travel experience while delivering a great experience to users.
 
 Your itinerary
 What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day. 
 You will:
 Own the Social & Follower experience end-to-end, from sharing functionality and growth loops to follower engagement features, likes, comments, and trip interaction.

 Drive growth for key metrics: MAU, sharing rates, and social engagement, setting the bar and holding yourself to it.

 Design and run experiments to validate ideas fast. You won't guess when you can test.

 Work hand-in-hand with Growth & Marketing to align product initiatives with acquisition and retention goals, no silos, just shared wins.

 Translate messy, complex problems into small, testable stories, making outcomes clear for everyone on the team.

 Celebrate the small wins as much as the big ones. Incremental progress is still progress.

 
 The equipment in your backpack
 What we're hoping you'll bring with you. 
 ✅ 5+ years of PM experience, ideally with time spent in a Growth PM role
 ✅ Genuinely data fluent; you move from hypothesis to experiment to decision without losing momentum. You treat every dataset as a chance to get sharper, not just to confirm what you already know.
 ✅ A solid understanding of UX/UI and creating a great (app) experience to drive product growth
 ✅ Experience working on app-first consumer products (B2C is your world)
 ✅ Growth and marketing-minded, you understand funnels, loops, and what makes people come back
 ✅ Humble, collaborative, and energized by team wins, this role doesn't work in a silo
 ✅ Bonus: experience with social or community features, or products where sharing is core to the experience
 
 1st class extras
 Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet. 
 Salary range: Between EUR 70.000 - 80.000 (medior level) and EUR 85.000 - 95.000 (senior level) gross per year incl 8% holiday allowance (based on 40 hours/week). Where you land in the range depends on your experience and skills, to be evaluated during the interview process.

 Equity: You'll be able to participate in our Polarsteps SAR Plan

 A yearly free flight or train ride to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here. 

 A shiny MacBook to work your magic on.

 Hybrid working, our way. Work from home and the office, we ask everyone to be in the office 2 days a week. It’s how we stay flexible, focused, and meaningfully connected in person.

 An extensive home office set-up, everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk.

 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you). 

 Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar.

 Awesome monthly parties, as well as team trips away.

 A lively office in downtown Amsterdam, with travel costs reimbursed.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Core Product
jobs.description:
About us 
 Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the self-serve product experience for our SMB customers: small to medium brands selling on Shopify and beyond. The proposition for this segment is unbuilt, the squad is yours to shape, and you'll own the slice of ARR that comes with it. Working closely with engineers, designers, and AI researchers, you'll decide what gets built, why, and how it ships
 Location: Paris, hybrid 3 days in the office. We offer relocation support
 
 About the role
 Own a real slice of the self-serve product. From idea to shipped feature, you will build and execute the roadmap that solves problems for our users.

 Define the problem before the solution. Sharpen the user problem, then partner with design and engineering to ship work that feels effortless.

 Turn AI capabilities into products people want. Work hand-in-hand with our researchers and engineers to convert new model capabilities into shipped features that move usage and revenue.

 Stay close to the user. Talk to e-commerce sellers every week, and feed what you hear directly into roadmap decisions.

 Use data to decide, not to justify. Pull and interpret data yourself, form hypotheses, measure what shipped, and call what's next. You won’t need to wait around for someone else to run the query.

 
 About You
 You've shipped products you can defend in detail. Five+ years as a PM, with multiple launches where you can name the user problem, what you owned personally vs. the team, and the measured outcome.

 You've built B2B SaaS for self-serve customers. You know the mechanics of self-serve growth, retention, and pricing, not just enterprise sales cycles.

 AI has reshaped how you work. You use Claude or equivalent every day, for prototyping, testing with users, or automating the parts of the job that used to fill your calendar. The value you bring sits in strategy and direction, not in writing tickets.

 You have demonstrable product taste. You can show specific work where the details matter and explain the calls you made, including the ones you'd make differently now.

 You create clarity from ambiguity. Given a fuzzy problem, you take action rather than waiting for direction: you structure it, decide what matters, and move.

 You're data-fluent. You pull, interpret, and challenge data yourself, and use it to form a point of view rather than confirm one.

 You thrive in small teams with high autonomy. You can ship without being managed, and can operate in a fully remote, async-first environment that offers no scaffolding around you.

 Nice to have: experience building creative tools or any product where craft and visual quality matter; an understanding of photography or videography; entrepreneurial experience (you've started, built, or run something).
 
 Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging
 We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.
 That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave.

jobs.description:
About us 
 Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager, SMB E-commerce Growth to own activation, monetization, and retention for our SMB e-commerce segment across the Photoroom mobile and web apps. This is a growth role: you'll own the levers that turn sign-ups into retained subscribers, and the growth-led features that move them. From paywalls to pricing experiments and onboarding and discovery flows, you'll partner closely with User Acquisition on the handoff from paid to product, and with the core SMB product team on what gets built next.
 Location: Paris, we offer relocation support (Hybrid
 
 About the role
 Own a real slice of the growth funnel. Activation, paywall, pricing, or retention: you'll lead a squad and own a specific number end-to-end, deciding what gets tested, what gets built, and what gets killed.

 Move the metric, not just the backlog. Run a high-velocity experimentation program across web and mobile funnels. Ship A/B tests weekly, and bigger feature bets when the data calls for them.

 Find the insight, then build the feature. The best growth work is spotting why users drop off and shipping the change that fixes it. You'll do both.

 Work across web and mobile. Mobile and web funnels behave differently (App Store vs. card-on-file, push vs. email). You'll own both, and partner closely with the User Acquisition team on the handoff from paid to product.

 Use data to decide, not to justify. Pull and interpret data yourself, form hypotheses, measure what shipped, and call what's next. You won't need to wait around for someone else to run the query.

 
 About You
 You've moved real numbers on a subscription product. Five to eight years as a PM, with concrete activation, monetization, or retention wins you can name with the KPI, the change, and the percentage impact, owned by you, not by a team you sat on.

 You've worked on something with recurring revenue. Whether B2B SaaS, B2C subscription, or B2B2C, as long as your work was tied directly to revenue your experience will give you a leg up. Pure marketplace or pure free-product backgrounds will struggle here.

 You know how SMB sellers buy. You understand how SMB e-commerce sellers discover, evaluate, and adopt utility SaaS, the kind of motion behind Shopify, Canva, Klaviyo, Stripe, Klarna, Gorgias, Recharge, Loop, Wix, or Squarespace.

 You think in funnels. You understand activation curves, paywall psychology, trial design, and the difference between credit-based, feature-gated, and seat-based pricing, and you have opinions on which works where.

 You build with AI. You use Claude or equivalent to automate recurring tasks, and can explain how you set it up to help you ship faster.

 You're data-fluent. Comfortable with SQL and an analytics platform like Amplitude or Mixpanel; you build and interpret your own funnel without waiting for a data scientist, and you've shipped a high volume of A/B tests personally in the last 12 months.

 You thrive in small teams with high autonomy. You can ship without being managed, and can operate in a fully remote, async-first environment that offers no scaffolding around you.

 Nice to have: experience on both web and mobile funnels; familiarity with the Shopify ecosystem (app store, connect flows, merchant personas) or a comparable e-commerce platform; entrepreneurial experience (you've started, built, or run something).
 If you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to chat and see if you could be a great fit.

 Role Summary
 We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own the AI platform every Photoroom product is built on. Our mission is that any team ships best-in-class GenAI visuals without needing a backend engineer: the primitives, the gateway and the no-code tooling turn adding an AI capability into a configuration step rather than an engineering project. On top of that sits the agentic layer — multi-step visual workflows that generate, check, reason, route and publish on their own. Working closely with engineers, ML researchers, and the product teams who ship on your platform, you'll decide what gets built, why, and how it ships.
 Location: Paris, (Hybrid)
 
 About the role
 Own the platform every AI feature runs through. Expand and improve our AI gateway, including safeguards, evals, cost and observability, giving teams the ability to ship with little to no code and build skills that we can ship directly to users.

 Build the agentic layer and Photoroom’s MCP. Visual agents that run multi-step flows: generate, QA, route, retry, publish, all unattended and at catalog scale.

 Define the problem before the solution. Sharpen the problem, then partner with engineering and research to ship work that feels effortless — for the developers and PMs using the platform as much as for end users.

 Treat other teams as your customers. Every team's roadmap contains AI features gated on platform work. You'll prioritise across them, hold a strategy rather than a request queue, and say no with reasons.

 Turn AI capabilities into products people want. Work hand-in-hand with our researchers and engineers to convert new model capabilities into shipped features that move usage and revenue, and turn them into primitives other teams can reuse.

 Use data to decide, not to justify. Pull and interpret data yourself, such as adoption, latency, inference cost per successful generation, eval results. Form hypotheses, measure what shipped, and call what's next. You won't need to wait around for someone else to run the query.

 About You
 You've shipped products users love. 10+ years as a PM, with multiple launches where you have solved a user’s problem and delivered business outcomes.

 You've built platform, infrastructure or developer-facing products. APIs, SDKs, internal platforms, ML infrastructure — products whose users are engineers.

 You've shipped something agentic or model-backed into production. You understand evals, guardrails, non-deterministic output, cost per call, and what breaks when a multi-step flow runs unattended a million times.

 AI has reshaped how you work. You use Claude or equivalent every day, for prototyping, testing with users, or automating the parts of the job that used to fill your calendar. The value you bring sits in strategy and direction, not in writing tickets.

 You have demonstrable product taste. You can show specific work where the details matter and explain the calls you made, including the ones you'd make differently now. On a platform, taste shows up in the interface you make other people build against.

 You create clarity from ambiguity. Given a fuzzy problem, you take action rather than waiting for direction: you structure it, decide what matters, and move.

 You're data-fluent. You pull, interpret, and challenge data yourself, and use it to form a point of view rather than confirm one.

 You thrive in small teams with high autonomy. You can ship without being managed, and can operate in a remote, async-first environment that offers no scaffolding around you.

jobs.title: Product Line Manager
jobs.description:
About Wallee Group AG
 Wallee Group is a leader in advanced payment solutions, dedicated to providing robust, scalable, and secure systems across multiple domains. We enhance customer experiences through innovative payment and finance technology that empowers businesses to grow efficiently. With operations spanning several countries, we thrive on collaboration and agility, utilizing the Scrum framework to drive our international teams. At Wallee, we stay at the forefront of market trends, continuously innovating to deliver premier services to our global customers.
 The Role 
 The Product Line Manager owns the full lifecycle of a product line - from introduction through to controlled end-of-life. The role combines strategic portfolio and roadmap management with subject matter expertise in specific verticals, bringing market, product, and supplier perspectives into one consistent strategy.
 In Wallee's payment technology context, this specifically includes managing hardware/firmware generations (e.g., terminal models, certification versions like the EMV L2 kernel) and forward-looking planning for successor products.
 The Impact You’ll Make 
 Drive Full Lifecycle & Strategy: Own the product journey from concept to decommissioning—defining launch criteria, target segments, success metrics, and forward-looking successor products before hardware/firmware generation changes.

 Optimize the Portfolio: Maintain a structured view of all variants (terminal types, SoftPOS vs. hardware POS) using frameworks like the BCG matrix to prioritize investment and avoid overlap/cannibalization.

 Build Capacity-Synced Roadmaps: Translate strategic goals and vertical needs into prioritized, time-boxed feature roadmaps (e.g., quarterly or PI planning in SAFe), balancing "run the business" compliance updates against "grow the business" initiatives.

 Champion Vertical Expertise & Research: Act as the "translator" between vertical requirements (e.g., retail, hospitality, events) and engineering's technical language while running ongoing trend scanning (PCI/EMV updates), competitor analysis, and customer feedback synthesis.

 Lead Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement: Define launch plans (positioning, pricing, training, documentation), coordinate alignment across Sales, Marketing, and Support, and assist Sales with technical expertise on complex, regulated deals.

 Manage Suppliers & Ecosystems: Onboard and manage external partners (terminal manufacturers, component suppliers, certification labs), overseeing SLAs, operational forecasting, defect escalations, contract negotiations, and risk mitigation (such as dual-sourcing).

 What Success Looks Like 
 Strategic Portfolio Health: A clear, non-overlapping product line where investments are prioritized effectively and End-of-Sale (EOS) / End-of-Life (EOL) migration paths are seamlessly executed.

 Uncompromising Compliance: Continuous alignment with certification and regulatory standards (PCI, EMV, ep2) across the entire portfolio, eliminating compliance risk.

 Reliable Supplier Alignment: High-performing partner relationships with well-managed SLAs, aligned roadmaps, and secure supply chains.

 Market-Driven Innovation: Roadmaps and GTM materials that accurately reflect vertical user journeys, market trends, and validated customer needs.

 Cross-Functional Readiness: Seamless coordination with internal teams so all departments are aligned and fully enabled from day one of product launches.

 What You Bring to the Table 
 Product Experience: Proven experience in product management, ideally with portfolio or product line ownership in fintech, payments, or hardware-enabled software.

 Domain Knowledge: Understanding or familiarity with payment certification and compliance topics (PCI, EMV, ep2) is a strong plus.

 Vertical & Market Expertise: Experience or strong interest in specific industry verticals, coupled with a track record in market research and competitor analysis.

 Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with a solution- and customer-oriented approach.

 Stakeholder & Supplier Management: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, comfortable managing both internal stakeholders and external supplier relationships.

 Languages: Fluent in English and German.

 Why Join Wallee? 
 Modern Workspace: A beautiful office in the heart of Winterthur - comfortable, bright, and collaboration-ready.

 True Flexibility: Flexible daily hours and a 4-week "Work from Anywhere" policy every year.

 Innovation First: We work with the latest tech stacks in a flat hierarchy where your voice actually matters.

 Growth & Culture: Competitive compensation , aligned with experience, seniority, and expertise, personal development budgets , and a social calendar filled with events .

 The Perks: Fresh fruits, snacks, and high-quality coffee to keep you fueled.

 
 Don’t tick every box? Neither do most great hires. If the role feels right, reach out, we’d love to see if we’re a m

 Eye Security is providing cybersecurity with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organizations in Europe. Headquartered in the Netherlands, we are already over 190 FTEs and continue to grow internationally having secured our Series C funding of €60 Million!

jobs.title: AI Project Manager
jobs.description:
ParetoLabs is looking for an experienced and structured (Senior) AI Project Manager to lead AI projects for our clients from first idea to production.
 As part of our dynamic team, you will be the link between our clients, our engineers and the AI technologies we build with. You will scope projects, steer delivery and make sure what we ship creates real value in Swiss companies across a wide range of industries.
 About ParetoLabs 
 ParetoLabs is a Zurich-based software studio that develops customized, AI-powered applications for conversational and text-processing use cases. We help companies quickly test, implement, and scale AI applications within their specific business environments.
 Founded in 2023, ParetoLabs is a Microsoft for Startups partner that combines innovative AI technologies with the individual requirements of Swiss companies.
 Tasks
 Lead AI projects end to end — retrieval assistants, copilots and agents — from discovery and scoping to rollout and operation.
 Translate business problems into clear use cases, requirements and success criteria together with our clients.
 Plan and steer delivery with our engineering team: scope, timeline, budget, risks and priorities.
 Define how quality is measured and make sure solutions are evaluated before and after go-live.
 Work with client stakeholders on data, security, compliance and change management.
 Collaborate closely with our multicultural team and bring your own ideas to projects with real-world impact.
 Requirements
 Experience: Several years of project management in software, data or digital transformation projects; AI or data projects are a strong plus.
 AI Understanding: A solid grasp of how large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and AI agents work, what they are good at and where they fail.
 Technical Foundation: Enough understanding of software architecture and cloud infrastructure (ideally Microsoft Azure) to discuss solutions with engineers and client IT and security teams.
 Methods: Confident with agile delivery and with structuring ambiguous problems into concrete plans.
 Stakeholder Management: Experience working with business and IT stakeholders up to management level, including managing expectations about what AI can and cannot do.
 Data & Compliance: Awareness of data protection (Swiss FADP, GDPR) and information security in client projects.
 Communication Skills: Excellent German and English, written and spoken.
 Mindset: Structured, hands-on and curious, with the ownership to bring projects over the finish line.
 Benefits
 Competitive Remuneration: A competitive salary package, reflecting your experience and contributions.
 Pick Your Gear: Choose your preferred devices for work.
 Attractive Benefits: above market pension benefits and a private accident insurance.
 Professional Growth: Participation in the Microsoft for Startups program, offering access to valuable resources, events and support.
 Interested in leading AI projects that make a real difference? We would be happy to hear from you.
 Please send us your CV and, if available, examples of projects you have led.
 Join ParetoLabs and shape how Swiss companies put AI to work!

jobs.title: Sr Product Marketing Manager, Platform
jobs.description:
Product Marketing turns Chainalysis innovation into customer value. We position our intelligence as solutions customers can understand and consume through our platform, shape how we commercialize them, and give GTM the stories and strategic assets to win. Customers reach our intelligence through products, AI agents, workflows, APIs, data and expert services. This role owns what those add up to. Our segment leads make it specific to an industry; you make the case for Chainalysis as a whole, and build the programs that grow each customer over time.
 
 As Senior Product Marketing Manager for Platform, you will own the positioning for the Chainalysis platform as a whole, then turn it into the lifecycle campaigns and programmes that drive adoption, usage and expansion across our customer base.
 
 This is a horizontal role working across every segment. It suits a problem solver rather than a feature marketer: you start from what customers are trying to do and what gets in their way, then work back to what we offer. You are metrics-savvy. You know what moves the needle and which levers to pull to meet an objective. You will work closely with Product, Sales, Customer Outcomes, Marketing & Communications and GTM Solutions & Readiness, alongside the segment leads who go deep on their industries.
 
 In this role, you'll: 
 Position the value 
 Define and evolve the Chainalysis story: what our intelligence enables, why we are meaningfully different, and why the whole is worth more than any one part.

 Build the messaging that lets GTM teams tell that story consistently.

 Own competitive positioning: frame the category and turn market moves into guidance deal teams can act on.

 
 Build the programmes that grow it 
 Build the lifecycle campaigns that take customers deeper into the platform and scale them in partnership with demand generation, product and sales strategy: onboarding, activation, expansion and renewal, each with its own message and moment.

 Spot the expansion patterns that hold across segments and turn them into cross-sell and upsell plays: the trigger, the message, the proof, and the asset a seller uses.

 Explain our commercial model in the customer’s terms, so buyers can see how what they use connects to what they get.

 Lead go-to-market planning for launches that span the portfolio, working with segment leads on the value proposition for each audience.

 
 Win and learn in market 
 Produce the strategic content that moves these conversations forward: first-call decks, value maps, discovery frameworks, ROI stories, objection handling and sales plays.

 Partner with Product, Product Marketing, GTM & Enablement teams to turn the strongest narratives into field tools sellers can find and use without asking.

 Turn churn, win-loss, field feedback and competitive signal into sharper positioning, and measure what reflects business health rather than activity.

 
 We're looking for candidate who have: 
 8+ years in product, solutions, industry, or B2B enterprise technology marketing.

 Experience building something from nothing: a new proposition, segment or business line where there was no playbook.

 Positioning that changes how customers and sellers see a problem, and connects many capabilities into one value story.

 Experience designing lifecycle campaigns or expansion programmes where you owned the messaging and mechanics.

 Exceptional writing and editorial judgment. You can write crisp headlines, persuasive narratives, practical sales content, and executive-level messaging; you know the difference between jargon and precision.

 A collaborative self-starter, comfortable driving ambiguous, multi-stakeholder work forward across Product, Sales, technical and revenue teams, and senior leaders.

 
 Nice to have experience: 
 Experience with blockchain, digital assets, or crypto-native financial infrastructure.

 Experience marketing AI-powered products, data platforms, intelligence products, cybersecurity, or risk and compliance technology.

 Familiarity with consumption- or usage-based pricing and packaging.

 
 You’ll thrive here if: 

You enjoy connecting many products into one story more than marketing a single product in isolation. You build from first principles and create structure where none exists. You write with precision, build for repeatability rather than one-off requests, and care about the quality of what reaches customers and the field. You know when to go deep and when to simplify, and help raise the standard of the work around you.
 
 AI at Chainalysis 
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it unique

You'll be expected to build a strong testing culture, translate ambiguous commercial questions into a rigorous experimentation agenda, and communicate results and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION 
 To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.
 What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.
 In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.
 And we’re a long way from done!

 THE ROLE 
 Buying and selling a car should feel like one seamless motion for a dealer, not two separate systems. Right now it's the opposite: a dealer buys through us, then has to manage collection, payment and resale largely on their own, stitching together workflows across multiple platforms and channels, much of it manual.
 For a dealer, speed is money. Every extra day a car sits before it's collected, priced, and paid for is a day of depreciation, tied-up capital, and a missed chance to buy the next one.If we can get a dealer from 'I've bought this car' to 'it's ready and paid for' faster through transport and collections, quicker final pricing, and Wallet, we make them more profitable. A dealer who's more profitable because of Carwow has little reason to go elsewhere: they'll lean on us more, and churn less.
 This role owns that last-mile agenda: getting cars collected quickly, resolving final price without friction, and making Wallet work the way dealers expect it to. This team sits across our ambitions to make car changing a seamless journey, this role's job is the handover itself: the operational moment between buying and being ready to sell again. This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. Dealers are already asking for smarter scheduling, less manual chasing, and tools that reduce the overhead of running a business. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise. If you want to own an operational product area end to end, work with some of the most sophisticated buyers in UK retail, and build things that have a direct line to commercial outcomes, this is it.
  
 WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING 
 Product Strategy & Execution: 
 Own the product direction for Carwow's dealer-facing product, defining what we build, in what order, and why

 Lead discovery work with dealers, interviews, on-site visits, data analysis to build a precise understanding of where we can add the most value

 Identify and test opportunities to bring AI into dealer workflows: smarter recommendations, vehicle pricing, performance insights that actually change behaviour

 Collaborate with Tech Lead, Designer, and Engineers to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics

 Manage the backlog with commercial awareness prioritising work that drives engagement, retention, and revenue, not just activity

 
 Partner Engagement & Insight: 
 Build relationships with key dealer partners and use those relationships to validate product direction before we build

 Work with Account Management and Sales to understand what's driving churn, what's blocking adoption, and what would make carwow stickier

 Translate qualitative partner feedback into structured product insight; don't just collect opinions, turn them into decisions

 
 Cross-functional Leadership: 
 Work across product, engineering, commercial, and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently

 Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal

 Support the commercial team on partner conversations where product context matters: capability deep-dives, roadmap discussions, strategic accounts

 
 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 
 1.5+ years of product management experience in a B2B or SaaS environment, with evidence of improving engagement or retention metrics

 Hands-on experience with product discovery: you run your own interviews, interrogate your own data, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for research to land in your inbox

 Genuine curiosity about AI, you follow what's happening, you have a point of view on where it adds real value, and you're eager to experiment

 Comfort with ambiguity: this role involves defining the problem as much as solving it, and the scope will evolve

 Strong stakeholder instincts, you can build trust with commercial teams, technical partners, and senior stakeholders without losing your own point of view

 Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you

 We are rebuy, pioneers in the sustainable reuse of electronics and media, and we are looking for you! Our mission: to make circular living accessible to all, one transaction at a time. By giving products a second chance, we reduce resource consumption and avoid unnecessary e-waste.
